about: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next EXL3 3.05bpw_h5_ng5 on one RTX 3090: experts in pinned RAM behind a GPU expert cache, n-gram table on NVMe, 5-bit QSA KV (trellis-serve flashnext-phase-d b1e74af, text + images)
setup: NEEDS: 1x RTX 3090 24 GB (the server takes the whole card: 21,108 MiB at ready, 24,104 MiB after the full protocol incl. a 196k-token prompt; the expert cache auto-sizes to free VRAM, so nothing else may use the GPU); 75 GB of free system RAM (page-locked: 45.8 GB routed experts + 8 GB n-gram row cache + 1.18 GB token embedding; system-wide MemAvailable fell 64 GB at ready and 65 GB at its lowest in SHIPD, with the buffered n-gram reads sharing the page cache, so 75 GB leaves headroom; the container is capped at --memory 100g); 86 GB for the weights on a LOCAL NVMe SSD (52.3 GB of shards read once at load; the 32.6 GB n-gram table is random-read while serving, so no network or tmpfs filesystem). Text and images (256x256 to 4096x4096 tested; EXL3 ViT decoded to bf16 at load, CPU preprocessing, SDPA ViT attention, ViT MLP chunk 8192). Phase D defaults: 5-bit QSA KV (SGLANG_EXL3_KV_BITS=5, 9,216 B/token, baked into the image and passed here), expert-cache reserve 8.26 GB (11.08 GB of experts on the card), --chunked-prefill-size 12288, --memory 100g. Launch = trellis-serve cuda/scripts/serve_flashnext_3090.sh at b1e74af plus --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder, on a bridge network with --shm-size 64g --memory 100g (SHIPD ran exactly this on the published digest; INT058b ran the script with --ipc=host --ulimit memlock=-1). First start JIT-compiles the n-gram NVMe extension (~1 min). Published-digest run SHIPD-3090-bc34655e (omarchy, PCIe 4.0 x16, 26.2 GB/s host-to-device): prefill medians 8k 2,920.1 / 16k 2,857.9 / 32k 3,055.3 / 64k 2,972.2 tok/s; decode aggregate C1 61.18 / C2 76.51 / C3 87.37 / C4 83.40 tok/s, C1 at 32k context 61.92; lab gates (load chat reasoning tools context speed) all pass, 67.5 tok/s in the 30 s streamed window, prefill 2,723 tok/s on the 0.85-context prompt. Source build (INT058b, same commit): prefill 8k 2,790.4 / 16k 2,733.3 / 32k 3,027.1 / 64k 2,910.0; decode C1 61.39 / C2 79.83 / C3 86.75 / C4 78.55. Quality vs stock exllamav3 on the published digest: text panel top-1 0.9910 / KL 0.00094 (INT058b 0.9920 / 0.00099); vision gate top-1 0.9853 / KL 0.00507, 8/8 answers correct (INT058b 0.9809 / 0.00584); receipt read correctly. Context 204,800, KV pool 209,984 tokens; 196,376-token needle found in 70.7 s (INT058b 72.3 s). A rented 3090 with 14-16 GB/s host-to-device decoded 53.2 tok/s (V001b): PCIe bandwidth matters. SGLANG_EXL3_NGRAM_TIER=pinned keeps the n-gram table in RAM instead (+24.6 GB RAM, no NVMe needed). Video input (4 s mp4 as a video_url data URL) was verified on the previous image ce47df25 (SMOKEVID-3090-ce47); the video path is unchanged in b1e74af.
